In [[descriptive set theory]], a '''coanalytic set''' is a [[Set (mathematics)|set]] (typically a subset of a [[Polish space]]) that is the [[Complement (set theory)|complement]] of an [[analytic set]].{{sfnp|Kechris|1995|p=87}} In the [[projective hierarchy]], coanalytic sets correspond to <math>\mathbf{\Pi}^1_1</math> sets.
